test_title: RRB NTPC - Graduate 2025 (CBT 2) Foundational Full Test - 10
subject: general
question: Which of the following statements is incorrect regarding World Radio Day 2026?

options.text: It is observed annually on February 13th to recognize the enduring power of radio.
The global theme for the year 2026 is "Radio: A tool, not a voice."
It marks the anniversary of the first broadcast by the United Nations Radio in 1946.
UNESCO proclaimed this day in 2011 to celebrate radio as a medium for information and entertainment.

solution:
The correct answer is __**The global theme for the year 2026 is "Radio: A tool, not a voice."**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **On February 13, 2026, the world celebrated the 15th edition of World Radio Day.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **Statement 2 is incorrect:** The theme for World Radio Day 2026 is **“Radio and Artificial Intelligence: AI is a tool, not a voice,”** emphasizing the medium's role in human expression, connection, and democracy rather than just being a mechanical instrument.
 
• The **theme **of World Radio Day 2026 is “Radio and Artificial Intelligence: AI is a tool, not a voice.”
 
• World Radio Day was first proclaimed by the Member States of **UNESCO** in 2011 and adopted by the United Nations General Assembly in 2012.
 
• **Historical Significance:** February 13 was chosen because it marks the day in 1946 when the **United Nations Radio** was established.
 
• Significance of Radio__
 __
 
• Radio remains the most widely consumed medium globally, reaching the widest audience including marginalized communities.
 
• It plays a vital role in emergency communication, disaster relief, and providing access to information in remote areas.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Radio in India__

 __
 
• **Akashvani (All India Radio)** is one of the largest broadcasting organizations in the world.
 
• The popular program **'Mann Ki Baat'** hosted by the Prime Minister has further highlighted the relevance of radio in modern Indian governance.
 
 
 
• Recent Innovations__
 
 
• The transition to Digital Radio Mondiale (DRM) and FM expansion in border and aspirational districts are key focus areas for the Indian government.
